title: net.tool — run one network tool from the host or inside a container's network namespace (feature net.tools, docs/plans/network/tools.md)
description: Output streams as stdout events. A tool that exits non-zero fails the command with its exit code (124 timeout, 127 not installed). Each tool accepts only its own fields; the agent re-validates.

target.description: ping, traceroute, dns, tcp: a hostname or an IP address (never starts with '-')

count.description: ping: echo requests (default 4, at most 20); tcp: connection attempts (default 3, at most 10)

record_type.description: dns (default A; PTR takes an IP target)

nameserver.description: dns: ask this server (an IP) instead of the namespace's resolver

connect_to.description: http: connect to this IP instead of resolving the URL's host (curl --resolve)

insecure.description: http: skip certificate verification (flagged in the output)

timeout_s.description: default 30; the process group is killed past it

container.description: run in this container's network namespace (nsenter --net=/proc/<pid>/ns/net), resolving with its resolv.conf and hosts file. Fails with "No running container to run the tool in (is it deployed?)" when nothing matches

labels.description: the newest running container carrying all of them (falak.site, or the compose project and service labels)
